verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the story end to end: targeting rules and custom rules ([launchdarkly-docs-1], [launchdarkly-docs-29]), contexts with attributes ([launchdarkly-docs-20]), reusable segments and converting rules into segments ([launchdarkly-docs-21], [launchdarkly-docs-25]), individual targeting ([launchdarkly-docs-2]), and testing targeting changes ([launchdarkly-docs-3]). A community user independently confirms rules-based targeting at group level and rollouts by attribute ([launchdarkly-comm-9]). Missing for 10: the doc citations are titles only, with no detail on rule operators or segment mechanics, and there is no hands-on corroboration that segments specifically work as described.
